from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, Border, Side
import os

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/50768/1_50768_init.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/50768_0_81d36932/1_50768_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Formula to automatically list matching Risk IDs for each matrix cell.
# Rows use Impact labels in E12:E14, columns use Likelihood labels in F15:H15.
for row in range(12, 15):
    for col in range(6, 9):  # F:H
        col_letter = ws.cell(row=15, column=col).column_letter
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value = (
            f'=TEXTJOIN(", ",TRUE,FILTER($A$4:$A$9,'
            f'($B$4:$B$9=$E{row})*($C$4:$C$9={col_letter}$15),""))'
        )
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)

# Add light borders to the 3x3 matrix for clarity

for row in range(12, 15):
    for col in range(6, 9):

wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
